content: 1. The Journal of Trauma, published in 1997, volume 42, pages 504–513, contains a study or article relevant to trauma care and management. 2. The Ghana Medical Journal, published in 2001, volume 35, pages 1–3, discusses the development of trauma systems in Ghana. 3. Mock C, Arreola-Risa C, and Quansah R authored a study titled Strengthening care for injured persons in less developed countries: a case study of Ghana and Mexico, which was published in Injury Control and Safety Promotion in 2003, volume 10, pages 45–51. 4. Nicholl J authored an article on prehospital deaths resulting from accidental injuries, which was published in the British Medical Journal in 1994, volume 309, page 57. 5. Nicholl J, Brazier JE, and Snooks HA conducted a study on the effects of the London helicopter emergency medical service on survival rates after trauma. This study was published in the British Medical Journal in 1995, volume 311, pages 217–222. 6. A study titled The cost and benefits of paramedic skills in prehospital trauma care was published in Health Technology Assessment in 1998, volume 2, issue 17, pages 1–72. 7. An article titled The cost of injury was published in Emergency Medicine Clinics of North America in 1993, volume 11, pages 241–253. 8. Tamburlini G and colleagues evaluated guidelines for emergency triage assessment and treatment in developing countries. Their findings were published in the Archives of Disease in Childhood in 1999, volume 81, pages 478–482.
